card.name: Day number after French weekday
card.fires_on: The day number (such as 7) after a French weekday like "samedi" and before a French month name like "avril". Weaker, scattered hits appear on odd letter pieces inside names and acronyms.

modes.label: French date day number
modes.description: The number between a French weekday and the month name avril.

modes.description: Scattered weak hits on a capital letter or piece inside an acronym or name.
